purpose: FLY-1884 P0-A hard gate: determine whether cmux exposes stable create-command identity at the workspace mutation boundary

cases.name: long_lived_committed_managed_view
cases.observation: title reflects the live foreground tmux/window title; no command or launch argv field exists

cases.name: existing_prepared_default_title_dead_surface
cases.observation: the exact production failure shape carries no surface evidence that distinguishes a managed attach from a founder shell

cases.name: fresh_self_owned_default_title_fixture
cases.cleanup: cmux close-workspace --workspace workspace:93 returned OK workspace:93
cases.observation: surface launch identity is unavailable, while native workspace UUID is returned and can be re-read with ref/title via list-workspaces --id-format both

conclusion: surface-command proof is impossible on cmux 0.61.0 for the prepared-abort shape; use immutable workspace UUID plus generation/ref/title re-read instead
